senses.gloss: טַלֵּיל to make a טְלָלָא; to cover, screen.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on I Kings 6:9">Targ. I Kings VI, 9</cite> (h. text <he>ספן</he>).
Targ. Y. Ex. XL, 21 (O. Af; h. text ויסך).
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Exodus 25:20">Ib. XXV, 20</cite> <he>מְטַלְלִין</he> (O. <he>מַטְּלִין</he>); a. fr.—
Succ. 31ᵃ (a beam) דגזלה ומְטַלֵּל עלה Ms. M. (ed. דגזולה only) which one stole and put upon it the covering of the Succah, v. מְטַלַּלְתָּא.—Part. pass. מְטַלַּל, f. מְטַלְּלָא.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 50b:13">B. Kam. 50ᵇ</cite> <he>משום דמט׳</he> because the cave is roofed.
Ib. דלא מְטַלְּלֵי which are uncovered.—Trnsf. to obscure.
<cite ref="Shabbat 78a:4">Sabb. 78ᵃ</cite> <he>מסו ומְטַלְּלֵי</he> they heal (the eye-sore) but dim the eye-sight.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 4:5">Targ. Is. IV, 5</cite>, sq.; a. fr.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 68:14">Targ. Ps. LXVIII, 14</cite> <cite ref="M00994"><he>מִיטַּ׳</he></cite> (some ed. <he>מְט׳</he>, v. supra).
<cite ref="Targum of I Chronicles 2:55">Targ. I Chr. II, 55</cite>.
